# One review is an anecdote

`customer_support.heu.quality_assurance.one_review_is_an_anecdote` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A trend across many reviews is evidence; a single review is an anecdote — and the person being scored will treat both as fact.


## The heuristic

**A trend across many reviews is evidence; a single review is an anecdote — and the person being scored will treat both as fact.**


_Why:_ The sampling error on one interaction is enormous. Drawing a conclusion about a person from one review is both wrong and visibly wrong to them, and it discredits the whole programme faster than any amount of harsh scoring.
